import sys; sys.path.insert(0,str(WORK))
import numpy as np, json, os, shutil
from lib9 import *
d=np.load('final_design.npz'); coef=d['coef']; b=d['b']; Wd=d['Wd']; wnew=d['wnew']; mu0=d['mu0']; mun=d['mun']; beta=float(d['beta']); c=float(d['c'])
os.makedirs('backup_pre_final',exist_ok=True)
names=['bert.encoder.layer.0.attention.self.value.weight','bert.encoder.layer.0.attention.self.value.bias']+['bert.encoder.layer.11.'+n for n in ['attention.output.dense.weight','attention.output.dense.bias','intermediate.dense.weight','intermediate.dense.bias','output.dense.weight','output.dense.bias']]
for n in names:
    if os.path.exists(f'edits/{n}.npy'): shutil.copy(f'edits/{n}.npy', f'backup_pre_final/{n}.npy')
print(sorted(os.listdir('backup_pre_final')))
gamma=0.7
# L0 carry
P0='bert.encoder.layer.0.'
Wv=W(P0+'attention.self.value.weight').astype(np.float64); bv=W(P0+'attention.self.value.bias').astype(np.float64)
Wv[56:64][:,KEEP]=0  # no-op guard
Vc=Wv[56:64].copy(); Vc[:,KEEP]=wnew[KEEP].T; Wv[56:64]=Vc
bv[56:64]=-wnew.T@mu0
save_edit(P0+'attention.self.value.weight', Wv.astype(np.float32)); save_edit(P0+'attention.self.value.bias', bv.astype(np.float32))
# L11
P='bert.encoder.layer.11.'
dg=np.full(768,c); dg[RES]=0.0
Wo=np.diag(dg); bo=-c*mun; bo[RES]=0.0
save_edit(P+'attention.output.dense.weight', Wo.astype(np.float32)); save_edit(P+'attention.output.dense.bias', bo.astype(np.float32))
W1=W(P+'intermediate.dense.weight').astype(np.float64); b1=W(P+'intermediate.dense.bias').astype(np.float64)
assert np.abs(Wd[:,RES]).max()==0
W1[:1008]=Wd; b1[:1008]=0
pairs=[]
for j in range(8):
    up,um=1008+2*j,1009+2*j
    assert W1[up,RES[j]]==1.0 and W1[um,RES[j]]==-1.0 and (np.abs(W1[up])>0).sum()==1 and (np.abs(W1[um])>0).sum()==1
save_edit(P+'intermediate.dense.weight', W1.astype(np.float32)); save_edit(P+'intermediate.dense.bias', b1.astype(np.float32))
W2=W(P+'output.dense.weight').astype(np.float64); b2=W(P+'output.dense.bias').astype(np.float64)
st=json.load(open('structure.json')); keep11=np.array(st['ffn_keep']['11']); assert (keep11==np.arange(1024)).all()
print('W2 KEEP rows kept units max', np.abs(W2[KEEP][:, :1024]).max(), 'b2 KEEP absmax', np.abs(b2[KEEP]).max())
W2[RES]=0.0
W2[np.ix_(RES,np.arange(1008))]=gamma*coef[:1008].T
for j in range(8):
    W2[RES[j],1008+2*j]=gamma*beta-1; W2[RES[j],1009+2*j]=-(gamma*beta-1)
b2[RES]=gamma*b
save_edit(P+'output.dense.weight', W2.astype(np.float32)); save_edit(P+'output.dense.bias', b2.astype(np.float32))
json.dump(dict(gamma=gamma), open('final_install.json','w'))
print('installed; params', param_count())
